description: This line plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny,” illustrates the change in Word Error Rate (WER) across six epochs for five different fine-tuning configurations of a Whisper model. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at integer intervals. The y-axis represents WER, scaled linearly from 30 to 70. The plot contains five distinct lines: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” is a solid gray line with circle markers, starting at a WER of 70 and decreasing to 32; “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” is a solid gray line with square markers, starting at 60 and decreasing to 35; “tiny int4” is a dashed gray line with circle markers, starting at 60 and decreasing to 39; “tiny int8” is a dashed gray line with square markers, starting at 50 and decreasing to 36; and “tiny full” is a dotted gray line with triangle markers, starting at 30 and decreasing to 25. All lines show a general downward trend in WER as epochs increase, with “tiny full” consistently achieving the lowest WER throughout the training period.
